label: Connection
description: Connect your Xero organisation with a custom connection. In Xero's developer portal (developer.xero.com, My Apps), create a Custom connection app with the scopes accounting.contacts, accounting.invoices, accounting.payments and accounting.settings.read, and send it to a user who can authorise it for your organisation. Once it is authorised, copy the Client id and generate a Client secret on the app's page, paste both here, save, and choose Test connection.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved client ID and secret with Xero and shows how the accounts, tax rates and payments are set up

fields.label: Send paid orders and refunds to Xero
fields.description: While this is on, an invoice is created in Xero when an order is paid, and a credit note when a payment is refunded.

actions.label: Retry failed documents
actions.hint: Tries again to create every document listed under Needs attention

modal.title: Retry failed documents
modal.description: Tries again to create every invoice and credit note that is listed under Orders > Xero documents > Needs attention, and finishes the ones that were interrupted. Use it after you corrected what stopped them, for example the connection or an account. A document that exists in Xero is never created twice.
